answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities: each agent locks 40 tokens and is paid only after 20 epochs of steady work prove it real. A grove of fresh accounts cannot fake that overnight, and a plume of copy-paste actions flags them for review, not payment. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 tokens; one honest agent pays 40 tokens and keeps its reward undiluted. A gale of cheap clones cannot afford that cost, so honest work wins.
